question_stem: A van of mass 2500 kg travelling at speed $v \mathrm{m s}^{-1}$ experiences a resistance force of $kv^2$ N. The constant power of the van's engine is 62.5 kW.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: Show that $k = 0.5$, and find the acceleration of the van when its speed is $25 \mathrm{m s}^{-1}$ on this straight horizontal road.
parts.part_stem: The steady speed that the van could maintain when moving along a straight horizontal road is $50 \mathrm{m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text: Find the value of $a$ and the value of $\theta$.
parts.part_stem: The van begins to ascend a hill inclined at an angle $\theta^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. The van travels along a line of greatest slope of the hill. The speed of the van at the start of the hill is $20 \mathrm{m s}^{-1}$, and its acceleration is $5a \mathrm{m s}^{-2}$. Later, on the same hill, the speed of the van is $30 \mathrm{m s}^{-1}$, and its acceleration is $a \mathrm{m s}^{-2}$. The power of the van's engine remains at $62.5 \mathrm{kW}$, and the resistance force remains at $0.5v^2 \mathrm{N}$.
